name: qa-unit-tests-net
description: .NET unit testing: 1 umbrella skill (dotnet-unit-tests) covering xUnit.net as the primary framework (Fact/Theory parametrization, fixtures, parallelism, CI), framework choice (xUnit for new projects; match an existing NUnit/MSTest convention), and test-authoring conventions, with NUnit, MSTest, and FluentAssertions (incl. the v8 license change) as references.
